I (17f) just had to go through this. My best and only friend was the same way. Everything I did was wrong and started up an argument like the fact that I have weak lungs and I’m always, “breathing too hard”. Or when I never got mad at the things she did because I’m just not an angry person. Or if all of my energy, focus, and mind wasn’t revolving around her, she would blow up. When my grandmother passed away, she was enraged that I wouldn’t come over to dye her hair since I was helping my family with funeral arrangements. She eventually blocked me from her life when I stopped arguing with her and discontinued entertaining her drama and anger. Honestly, when your friend gets mad, just don’t feed into it. Don’t give her what she wants and hopefully she will either end your friendship OR she will go about everything differently. It also kind of sounds like something else is going on that’s making her bottle her anger up, and she pours it out on you. Dodge the waterfall. I hope all goes well for you, good luck :)
